2608.04759.title: Trace, Verify, and Correct: A Training-Free Framework for Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs
2608.04759.paper_summary: Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made substantial progress, their spatial reasoning may still produce intermediate judgments inconsistent with the input image, allowing errors to propagate through the reasoning chain and affect the final answer. Existing methods mainly improve spatial reasoning through training or additional spatial information, without considering whether the reasoning process itself is faithful to the model input. Our study shows that unfaithful reasoning chains significantly reduce final-answer accuracy. To address this issue, we propose a modular and training-free framework for spatial reasoning verification and correction. The framework constructs a Spatial Evidence Graph (SEG), which associates atomic spatial evidence extracted from Chain-of-Thought reasoning with visual entities, spatial relations, source steps, and visual evidence. Spatial Evidence Reliability Assessment (SERA) evaluates the reliability of visual evidence based on object existence, localization, and geometric measurements. The framework then identifies the earliest spatial evidence unit contradicted by reliable visual evidence and guides the original MLLM to revise the subsequent reasoning and final answer. Across 15 model-dataset settings, our method achieves an average accuracy of 68.94%, outperforming the compared baselines by 8.55 percentage points on average. Our code will be open-sourced.
2608.04759.paper_summary_zh: 儘管多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）已經取得了顯著進展，但它們的空間推理仍可能產生與輸入圖像不一致的中間判斷，導致錯誤在推理鏈中傳播並影響最終答案。現有的方法主要通過訓練或額外的空間信息來改善空間推理，而未考慮推理過程本身是否忠實於模型輸入。我們的研究顯示，不忠實的推理鏈顯著降低了最終答案的準確性。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一個模組化且無需訓練的空間推理驗證與修正框架。該框架構建了一個空間證據圖（SEG），將從思維鏈推理中提取的原子空間證據與視覺實體、空間關係、來源步驟和視覺證據相關聯。空間證據可靠性評估（SERA）根據物體存在、定位和幾何測量來評估視覺證據的可靠性。然後，該框架識別出被可靠視覺證據矛盾的最早空間證據單元，並指導原始的MLLM修正後續推理和最終答案。在15個模型-數據集設置中，我們的方法達到了68.94%的平均準確率，平均超過了比較基準8.55個百分點。我們的代碼將開源。
